description: A test script for verifying the behavior of 'git p4' operations, specifically testing exclusion of paths during clone and sync operations with a Perforce repository.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds files to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: p4 submit
methods.description: Submits changes to the Perforce depot.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones Perforce depot contents into a Git repository, with options to exclude specific paths.

methods.name: git p4 sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the Git repository with the Perforce depot, with exclusion options.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists as a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success if the condition holds.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the Git repository after tests.
